user.title: RideRadar start location
user.description: Search for the place where your rides usually start. You can use a city, village, address, or landmark. Examples: `Brussels`, `Luxembourg City`, `Aachen Hbf`, `Market Square Maastricht`. RideRadar will show matching locations in a list.

choose_location.title: Choose start location
choose_location.description: Choose the location RideRadar should use as your trip start. Selecting a location accepts it.

settings.title: RideRadar trip settings
settings.description: Choose sensible defaults for ride range, forecast window, and destination areas. You can adjust dynamic planning controls from the dashboard later.

error.address_not_found: No location found. Try a larger nearby town, add the country name, or use a more specific address.

init.title: RideRadar settings
init.description: Current start location: **{address}**. Coordinates: **{latitude}**, **{longitude}**. Edit the address or place name to search for a new start location.

start_location.title: Change start location
start_location.description: Search for a new trip start. Examples: `Brussels`, `Luxembourg City`, `Aachen Hbf`, `Market Square Maastricht`. RideRadar will show matching locations in a list.

choose_location.title: Choose start location
choose_location.description: Choose the location RideRadar should use as your trip start. Selecting a location accepts it.

manual_start_location.title: Manual start coordinates
manual_start_location.description: Advanced fallback only. Prefer searching by place name first so RideRadar can resolve a readable address.

settings.title: Travel modes and approach times
settings.description: Configure which travel modes RideRadar may use and the normal and joker approach-time limits for each mode. The normal limit controls regular recommendations; the joker limit allows exceptional options to remain visible as jokers.

data.motorcycle_direct_joker_max_approach_tim: Maximum direct approach time for a joker
data.motorcycle_scenic_joker_max_approach_tim: Maximum scenic approach time for a joker
data.trailer_available: Do you have access to a trailer?
data.trailer_joker_max_approach_time_hours: Maximum trailer approach time for a joker

destinations.title: Enable or disable destinations
destinations.description: Select every destination area RideRadar should evaluate.

add_custom_destination.title: Add custom destination
add_custom_destination.description: Enter destination details and a place/address to resolve to coordinates.

choose_custom_location.title: Choose custom destination location
choose_custom_location.description: Select the location that matches the custom destination.

reset_defaults.title: Reset destinations
reset_defaults.description: This enables all default destinations and removes custom destinations.

advanced_import_export.title: Advanced destination import/export
advanced_import_export.description: Advanced only: paste structured destination JSON to replace custom destinations.
